paragraphs.text:
Fearing to touch the repulsive carcass, you use a dead branch to 
lever it into a ditch. You cut some shrubs to cover it and then 
return to the cave. By morning it appears safe to continue on 
your way.
Gain 1D6 Sanity for dispatching the creature. Go to 513.
